text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That wraps up today's training, doesn't 
it? Good work to—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Want to do a tandem run? You've been 
running alone all day today, haven't you?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You always catch the eye wherever you are. 
So, mind if I run with you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to run a workout with Or. That 
is alright, isn't it, Trainer?
choice_data_list:
Got it. Just make sure you don't push 
yourself too hard.

That'll lead to overwork. I can't allow 
it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I will take your advice to heart. We can't 
have Orfe overworking herself, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: So it seems. ...Another time, dear Sister.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Heh... A wise decision. Right, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, with Orfe saying that, I suppose 
I have no choice. I shall wait for the 
next opportunity.
